subject.title: fix(memory-wiki): propagate deadline signal and skip exhaustive fallback for supplement search

question: Should memory-wiki supplements intentionally return digest-only partial results on underfill while direct `wiki_search` remains exhaustive?
rationale: The patch fixes availability by trading away existing supplement result completeness, and source correctness plus green CI cannot determine whether that is the desired user-facing contract.

options.title: Accept bounded partial recall
options.body: Use digest-only wiki supplement results under `memory_search` and preserve exhaustive scanning for explicit `wiki_search`.

options.title: Require bounded backfill
options.body: Preserve more supplement completeness through a cancellable or indexed fallback that remains inside the tool deadline.

options.title: Defer to indexed search
options.body: Pause this semantic split until the FTS/index direction defines the long-term fast-search contract.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded partial recall
recommendation.body: Use digest-only wiki supplement results under `memory_search` and preserve exhaustive scanning for explicit `wiki_search`.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced both the digest underfill fallback and the corpus-supplement bridge whose contract this decision changes.
